subject: Spec review done: verdict FAIL, 11 blocking findings
body: I ran /sc:spec-panel-armb in critique mode (requirements, architecture) on the worker-contract spec without editing it, re-read its load-bearing citations at HEAD 2cb683f5c, and wrote review/spec-panel.md with a boundary table and 15 numbered findings. The section 1 decision holds, but the verdict is FAIL on 11 blocking findings: the WC-4 status field clashes with existing contracts (success vs succeeded), the report path is not computable for file-valued or generated folders, retries overwrite attempt 1, P1 makes --unattended a no-op before gates are converted, flag parsing and nested propagation are unspecified, source-editing workers have no isolation, the AC-C5/AC-0.3 grep misses deleted bullets, AC-0.4 cannot pass, long Agent-tool waits are uncovered, and the spec is stale against origin/master, which already ships WORKER-CONTRACT.md and an Orca-calling sc:issue skill. Left for Task 6: apply the Reviser brief at the end of the report and decide whether the spec targets HEAD or current master.
